# Atomic Shop Monthly Update: August 2026

04. August 2026

Check out the featured bundles and weekly sales for the month of August!

### Fallout 1st – August

From August 4 – September 8, claim your free GNN News Van (Survival Tent) in the Atomic Shop. Available for Fallout 1st members only. Learn how to become a Fallout 1st Member here.

### FREE Plushie – August

Each month you’ll be able to claim a new Alotolotl plushie from the Atomic Shop that coincides with the Monthly Axolotl you can catch in-game!

Starting August 4, catch the Striped Axolotl while fishing in certain locations, and claim the plushie version free in the Atomic Shop!

### Week of August 4
